title: Suppress timestamp-only batch projection rewrites in worker-wave runtime publisher
mission: Locate the current worker-wave runtime publisher and make the narrowest reversible change that prevents generated_at-only rewrites for semantically unchanged batch projections while preserving material runtime updates.
definition_of_done: Identify the current source workflow/script responsible for 'live: refresh worker wave runtime'.
Semantically unchanged batch projections no longer create a gh-pages diff solely because generated_at advanced.
A real worker-state transition still updates the affected batch and global runtime projections.
Existing concurrency, worker evidence, allocator authority and promotion semantics remain unchanged.
Record exact changed paths and a bounded verification result.
